visual_desc: EXTREME WIDE SHOT. The skeletal canyon of decaying skyscrapers rises under a toxic amber sky in Neo-Veridia. Broken neon signs flicker erratically, casting toxic magenta and green light. <Kael> (female, 30s, scarred, tattered black cloak) is a small, dark figure moving with professional tightness down the center of the cracked ferrocrete street. She stops precisely at the intersection of Rigel and 4th Sector, framed by the harsh, contrasting shadows of the flickering neon.
audio_desc: [Sound Effect] Mechanical groan of decaying infrastructure; the sputter of dying neon lights.

visual_desc: MEDIUM CLOSE-UP. The camera is focused tightly on <Kael>'s face and upper body. Her expression is strained but focused. Her right hand moves with practiced speed to her hip and draws the LUMINAR. As the ancient data-blade clears the scabbard, it erupts in a violent, cool SAPPHIRE BLUE light, illuminating <Kael>'s determined features and casting sharp blue shadows. Across the street, deep in shadow, two pinpricks of cold WHITE DATA briefly bloom where <The Oracle>'s head should be. Faint, dark energy lines web the ferrocrete near <The Oracle>'s feet.
audio_desc: [Speaker] Kael: "End it. Or give me the key." [Sound Effect] Audible, powerful HUM from the Luminar blade igniting, causing nearby neon buzz to stutter wildly.

visual_desc: The shot is an OVER-THE-SHOULDER composition, positioned behind <The Oracle>'s massive, dark robes, looking directly at <Kael>. <Kael> is centered, leaning forward, her face contorted in a guttural exertion of defiance, leveling the violently pulsing sapphire blade. She lunges forward. The shot rapidly CLOSES on the point of impact: brilliant blue energy meets the dense, light-absorbing darkness of <The Oracle>'s field. INSTANTANEOUS BLINDING WHITE FLASH engulfs the frame.
audio_desc: [Speaker] Kael: (Guttural ROAR) [Sound Effect] The sound abruptly CUTS OUT completely, replaced by the high-frequency echo of the blade’s hum rapidly fading into dead silence.
